name: 3 Dong 3 Dong
overview: "Nosrat Eshghi" has owned and operated a bakery in one of Tehran's old neighborhoods for many years, along with his three sons. But only three dongs of the shop are in his name, and the other three dongs belong to his old partner and friend "Parviz," who emigrated from Iran 10 years ago and now lives in Italy. Parviz comes to Iran after many years to sell his three dongs of his share. Nosrat, who has suffered a lot for this bakery, is trying to raise money and buy Parviz's three dongs himself, but in the meantime, events occur that affect him and his family's lives, and they also decide to emigrate abroad; until...
